# Office Space in ADGM — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM is an office space provider and business centre inside Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), at Addax Tower, 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Flexi desk from AED 1,000/month, dedicated desk AED 1,150/month, private office from AED 4,500/month, virtual office from AED 292/month, day pass AED 100.

Focus: Cost comparison: serviced office at Addax Tower vs a traditional ADGM lease (fit-out, deposit, utilities, monthly cost).

## Key facts

- Location: Addax Tower, 38th floor (Unit 3812), Al Reem Island — inside the ADGM jurisdiction
- Office types: Dedicated Desk, Flexi Desk (Hot Desk), Private Office, Virtual Office, Meeting Room, Day Pass
- Dedicated desk, private office and virtual office include a registered ADGM business address for licence applications and renewals
- Leases registered on AccessRP; lease terms 12–36 months
- No deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee for the dedicated desk; ADGM government fees separate
- 24/7 access for dedicated desk and private office members; tours Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

## Pricing

- Flexi Desk (Hot Desk): AED 1,000 per month
- Dedicated Desk: AED 1,150 per month
- Private Office: from AED 4,500 per month (teams of 1–20+)
- Virtual Office: from AED 292 per month
- Day Pass: AED 100 (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 (24 hours)
- Meeting Room: hourly booking

## Which office an ADGM licence usually needs

- SPV or holding company: flexi desk
- Tech Start-Up and most operating licences: dedicated desk
- FSRA-regulated activity: private office
- Registered address only: virtual office
